target_customer: Health-minded consumers wanting fast, flavorful, keto-friendly protein meals, sold through retail
problem: Plant-based meat had stalled on taste; Choppy blended plant protein with a small share of real animal fat, collagen and broth for flavor in a four minute entree.
business_model: Consumer packaged food sold through grocery retail
product_category: Hybrid plant and animal protein foods

founders.name: Saba Fazeli
founders.background_notes: Per YC page. Fortune (2024-02-17) says both founders were 29 then.

founders.name: Brice Klein
prior_employers: Plenty (fourth engineer, led commissioning of a farm)
education: Stanford, bachelor's and master's in mechanical engineering

exit.reason: YC lists Inactive; no closure report found.

competitors.name: Hoxton Farms
competitors.what: London startup growing cultivated animal fat to blend with plant-based meat, an adjacent approach to adding animal fat

competitors.name: Mission Barns
competitors.what: San Francisco company making cultivated pork fat for plant-based products, named alongside Hoxton as a competitor in 2021 coverage

technical_complexity.rationale: Formulating textured plant protein with animal fat and scaling production through co-packers is standard food engineering with some hard parts; founder Fazeli developed Beyond Meat's textured proteins per the YC page.

defensibility.rationale: Recipes are copyable and the product competes in a crowded frozen and prepared foods aisle; no patents or exclusive supply were found.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent response found; plant-based unit sales fell in 2022 per Fortune.

market_need_then: Plant-based meat sales were flat in 2020 to 2021 and fell in 2022 per Fortune (2024), which motivated hybrid products; the founders pitched 90 percent plants and 10 percent animal parts.

identity.voice_and_tone: Playful exclamation in the name; tagline FAST FLAVORFUL PROTEIN

branding.community_and_virality: Covered by Fortune (Feb 2024) and FoodNavigator-USA (May 2024) mainly as a hybrid meat story.

brand_strength.rationale: Some trade press, but the coverage focused on the hybrid concept, and sources tie the business to the Momentum Foods and Paul's Table names, which blurs the brand.

outcome_analysis: Choppy joined YC in Winter 2023 to sell hybrid plant and animal protein entrees, received trade press in 2024 and is now listed Inactive. No source explains why, so the cause is not public and no failure factors are assigned. Plant-based unit sales were falling when it launched.
notes: The $500K accelerator entry rests on a single database (PitchBook, Jan 2023); investor not named there and not recorded. FoodNavigator-USA (2024) called the company Jetstream-backed, with no amount or date, so it is not recorded as a round. The YC page bios refer to Momentum Foods and Paul's Table, and Fortune names Momentum Foods as the business, so the relationship between names is unclear. Competitors are adjacent fat suppliers; no direct hybrid-entree rival with a dated source was found. The Choppy website fetch returned only a title.
